## Purpose
`/mcp/$serverName`: one MCP server. It covers its tools, a playground to execute a tool, its registry entry, and disconnect, reconnect, health-check and remove.

## Responsibilities
`McpServerPage`:
- reads `mcpApi.servers` and `mcpApi.tools`;
- `ToolsCard`;
- `PlaygroundCard`: `mcpApi.execute`, with `CodeBlock` output;
- `RegistryCard`;
- `CopyAddress` ("URL copied.");
- disconnect ("Disconnected."), reconnect ("Reconnected."), healthCheck ("Health check complete.") and removeServer ("Removed …").

Titled "MCP Server — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`McpServerPage`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
MCP registry changes (Tool Service).

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/mcp/*`, proxied to the Tool Service `/mcp`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Health and tools are not persisted by the Tool Service.** After it restarts, servers read as unhealthy until checked.

As described.
